verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only paid Google One tiers (100 GB and 2 TB total storage) and API documentation. Nothing documents a free tier, a published free storage quota, or that free accounts get the same clients and API. Paid plan quotas and the API's existence do not show a free tier.

support.subject: As a power user, I can start free — a real free tier with published storage quota that works with the same clients and API
